summary: Replaces matching text in selected cells of an input DAT using pattern matching and substitution strings, preserving the input table dimensions.

key_params.name: match
key_params.note: Match anywhere, exact, at start, or at end

key_params.name: expand
key_params.note: Expand variables and back quotes in the Before string

key_params.name: expandto
key_params.note: Expand variables and back quotes in the After string

key_params.name: first
key_params.note: Replace only the first matched instance

key_params.name: xfirstrow
key_params.note: Exclude the first row from substitutions

key_params.name: xfirstcol
key_params.note: Exclude the first column from substitutions

key_params.name: extractrows
key_params.note: Scope rows by all, name, index, values, or condition

key_params.name: extractcols
key_params.note: Scope columns by all, name, index, values, or condition

key_params.name: customext
key_params.note: Custom editor extension when Extension is set to Custom Extension

key_params.name: extension
key_params.note: Edit/view file extension exposed to external editors

key_params.name: wordwrap
key_params.note: Common DAT node-display word wrap setting

common_gotchas: Output keeps the same number of rows and columns as the input; Substitute DAT changes cell strings, not table shape.
The second input can provide before/after substitution pairs in two columns, which can override simple single-rule assumptions.
Wildcard characters *, ?, and [] must be escaped with backslash when they should match literally.
Scope expressions operate from selected cells; generated expressions should use me.inputCell deliberately.
For simple Python string replacement or computed replacements, Evaluate DAT or Script DAT may be clearer.
key_concepts: Substitutes matched text in an input DAT using before/after patterns.
Match and Case parameters control matching mode and case sensitivity.
Expand controls output expansion behavior and target expansion values.
First row/column and row/column extraction controls limit which cells are substituted.
